description.value:
Kalashtar were born of the union of humanity with renegade spirits from the plane of dreams, the quori. They look human, but their spiritual bond marks them: their features are symmetrical and slightly angular, and their eyes often glow when they concentrate or feel strong emotions.

Kalashtar cannot speak directly with their quori spirits. Instead, they sense them as a source of instinct and inspiration, drawing on the spirits' memories while they sleep. This bond gives them minor psionic gifts and protects them from psionic attacks.

Kalashtar Traits

Creature Type: Aberration

Size: Medium (about 6–7 feet tall)

Speed: 30 feet

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.species.Item.XKKXfjvjE8r43B2n]{Dual Mind}. You have Advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.species.Item.y1zlRHKLpEMw4yZd]{Mental Discipline}. You have Resistance to Psychic damage.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.species.Item.A2ukC21a4A2H3Bka]{Mind Link}. You have telepathy with a range in feet equal to 10 times your level. While you speak telepathically to a creature this way, you can take a Magic action to let it speak telepathically to you for 1 hour, or until you take another Magic action to end this effect.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.species.Item.1bSQEWzoGkzHj5Pv]{Severed from Dreams}. You can't be the target of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDream00000]{Dream} spell. In addition, when you finish a Long Rest, you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice, which lasts until you finish another Long Rest.
